messages.subject: vabilo na spomladansko šolo ISRIC
messages.body_plain:
Posredujem vabilo na sopmladansko šolo <http://www.isric.org/content/isrics-spring-school-2013>, kjer se bo govorilo o preučevanje prsti. Veliko se bo delalo v R-u. Program je dosegljiv tule <http://www.isric.org/training/hands-global-soil-information-facilities>. Cena šole je slabih 300 €, prioriteto pa imajo študenti (ODA držav).

> Soil data producers and soil mappers involved in soil mapping and soil information production at regional, national and continental scales; soil experts and professionals in natural resources management and planning; soil science students at MSc and PhD level.

lp,
Roman

--
In God we trust, all others bring data.

Vabljeni.

messages.body_plain:

Predstavitveni video in ostale najave si lahko ogledate na strani od Courserae  <https://www.coursera.org/course/dataanalysis>oz. tukaj <http://blog.revolutionanalytics.com/2012/12/coursera-data-analysis.html>.

Se vidimo na oni strani.
